entries.keywords: what is coding programming code computer program beginner start
entries.a: Coding is writing step-by-step instructions that a computer follows. A program is a set of those instructions. Start with the web: HTML builds the page, CSS styles it and JavaScript makes it do things. Ask me for 'html example', 'css example' or 'javascript example'.

entries.keywords: html example hello world web page structure tags how to make a webpage
entries.a:
HTML uses tags to build a page. A simple page:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><title>My Page</title></head>
<body>
  <h1>Hello, Zimbabwe!</h1>
  <p>This is my first web page.</p>
</body>
</html>
Save it as index.html and open it in a browser.

entries.keywords: html tags list heading paragraph link image list button common elements
entries.a: Common HTML tags: <h1> heading, <p> paragraph, <a href="..."> link, <img src="..."> image, <ul><li> list, <button> button, <div> a box that groups things. Most tags open and close: <p>text</p>.

entries.keywords: css example style color font background layout how to style page
entries.a:
CSS styles HTML. Example:
body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background: #fff8e7; }
h1 { color: #0b6e4f; text-align: center; }
.button { background: gold; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; }
A name with a dot (.button) styles every element with class="button".

entries.keywords: javascript example js hello alert function variable beginner
entries.a:
JavaScript makes pages interactive. Example:
let name = "Tendai";
function greet(who) {
  return "Mhoro, " + who + "!";
}
console.log(greet(name));
let makes a variable. A function packages steps you can reuse.
